book.name: XHUN
book.title: QꞌU BꞌAꞌNLA CHAJ CHUSBꞌALTETZ U JESUUS ITZꞌIBꞌA U XHAN Unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Xhun tiꞌ u Jesús

content: Yeꞌ nikat inimal viyol u Jesús taꞌn unqꞌa titzꞌineꞌ

As xamtik veꞌt stuul, as aꞌ nikat ixaankat veꞌt u Jesús tulaj unqꞌa tenameꞌ tu u Galilea, tan jit isaꞌ Aak tatin tu u Judea, tan nikat ichuk unqꞌa iqꞌesal unqꞌa tenameꞌ txumbꞌal tiꞌ iyatzꞌpu veꞌt Aak.
As txantik ilejat u nimla qꞌiieꞌ uvaꞌ nik ilak unqꞌa tiaal Israel unqꞌa talaj ipacheꞌ tiꞌ tulsat skꞌuꞌl tiꞌ uvaꞌ kaꞌviinqil yaabꞌ kat atin unqꞌa qꞌesla ibꞌaaleꞌ tu u tzuukin txꞌavaꞌeꞌ.
As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa titzꞌin u Jesús ileꞌ ste: —Kuxh tu u Judea, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la til unqꞌa achusulibꞌeꞌ unqꞌa kꞌuchbꞌal tetz vibꞌaꞌnil u Tiixheꞌ uveꞌ nabꞌaneꞌ,
tan abꞌil uvaꞌ nisaꞌ uvaꞌ la ootzil taꞌn unqꞌa tenameꞌ as yeꞌ la uch imujat tibꞌ. As kuxh kꞌuch eebꞌ vatz unqꞌa tenameꞌ, asoj nim vabꞌaꞌnileꞌ nabꞌaneꞌ,— tiꞌk chajnaj,
tan mitaꞌn kuxh unqꞌa titzꞌin Aakeꞌ nikat niman Aak.
As ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —Yeꞌ ilejeꞌt u qꞌiieꞌ tiꞌ unbꞌen tu u nimla qꞌiieꞌ. Pet ech koj ex, tan kam kuxh qꞌiil la uch ebꞌeneꞌ.
As echeꞌ la koj tixva ex unqꞌa tenameꞌ. Pet ech koj in, tan ni tixva in unqꞌa tenameꞌ, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ ni valoꞌk ste uvaꞌ vaꞌlexh nibꞌaneꞌ.
As bꞌenoj etiltaj u nimla qꞌiieꞌ. Pet ech koj in, tan yeꞌl in la bꞌen in cheel, tan yeꞌ ilejeꞌt u qꞌiieꞌ tiꞌ unkꞌuchat vibꞌ vatz unqꞌa tenameꞌ,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
As tul yaꞌ Aak tiꞌ talat unqꞌa yoleꞌ, as kaa veꞌt Aak tu u Galilea.
Ni tex u Jesús tu u nimla qꞌiieꞌ
As tul kuxh bꞌen unqꞌa titzꞌin u Jesús tu u nimla qꞌiieꞌ, as bꞌen veꞌt Aak unpajte. As yeꞌ kat ikꞌuch Aak ibꞌeneꞌ. As jit ikꞌuch tibꞌ Aak vatz unqꞌa tenameꞌ.
As nik ichuk veꞌt unqꞌa iqꞌesal unqꞌa tenameꞌ Aak xoꞌl unqꞌa mamaꞌla tenameꞌ tu u nimla qꞌiieꞌ. As ech nikat tal chajnaj ileꞌ svatzaj: —¿Katil atkat u najeꞌ?— tiꞌk chajnaj.

As nik iyolbꞌe veꞌt unqꞌa tenameꞌ u Jesús. As at jolol uxhchil ech nik tal ileꞌ: —Chꞌiꞌumal itxumbꞌal u najeꞌ,— tiꞌk chajnaj. Pet ech koj unjolte, tan ech nik tal ileꞌ: —Yeꞌ bꞌaꞌn veꞌt nibꞌan u najeꞌ, tan nu kuxh iyansa naj itxumbꞌal unqꞌa kumooleꞌ,— tiꞌk chajnaj.
As nik kuxh ijutxi unqꞌa tenameꞌ iyoloneꞌ tiꞌ u Jesús, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ nik ixoꞌv chajnaj vatz unqꞌa iqꞌesal unqꞌa tenameꞌ.
As tul maꞌtik ipokꞌoꞌchin u nimla qꞌiieꞌ, as ok veꞌt u Jesús vatz iqꞌanal u tostiixheꞌ. As ichus veꞌt Aak unqꞌa tenameꞌ.
As sotz veꞌt ikꞌuꞌl unqꞌa iqꞌesal unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As ech tal veꞌt chajnaj ileꞌ: —¿Kam kat tulbꞌe u najeꞌ tootzit viyol u Tiixheꞌ? As tul yeꞌl naj kat ichus tibꞌ,— tiꞌk chajnaj.
As ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —Unqꞌa yoleꞌ uveꞌ nunchus sexoꞌl as jit ineꞌ ni alon. Pet aꞌ u chajol vetzeꞌ ni alon.
As abꞌil uvaꞌ la saꞌon ibꞌanat uveꞌ ni tal u Tiixheꞌ as la tootzi uvaꞌ ma xeꞌ Aak tzaanajkat unqꞌa yoleꞌ uvaꞌ nunchuseꞌ, pet moj nu kuxh uncheesa tunviꞌ.
As abꞌil uvaꞌ la kuxh icheesa umaj chusbꞌal tiviꞌ as jeꞌsaibꞌeꞌ nibꞌaneꞌ. Pet ech koj in tan aꞌ u chajol vetzeꞌ ni voksa iqꞌii, as jik chit nunchusuneꞌ. As yeꞌl umaj vaꞌlexh nunbꞌan sevatz.
¿As kam stiꞌ qꞌi uveꞌ netal unyatzꞌpeꞌ? As tul at veꞌt u tzaqꞌiteꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan sexoꞌl taꞌn u Moisés. As yeꞌl umaj ex ni niman, tan netal unyatzꞌpeꞌ,— tiꞌk Aak.
As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa tenam ileꞌ: —¡Subꞌuleꞌ atoꞌk sakꞌatz! ¿Abꞌil ni alon ayatzꞌpeꞌ?— tiꞌk unqꞌa tenameꞌ.
As ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —Tiꞌ kuxh umaꞌl u bꞌaꞌnil uveꞌ kat unbꞌan tu u xeem qꞌiieꞌ as kat teqꞌo etaama stiꞌ.

As la val sete, tul uvaꞌ nilej vaaxil qꞌii titzꞌebꞌ umaj neꞌ uvaꞌ xaak, as netzokꞌeꞌl unbꞌiil vichiꞌoleꞌ echeꞌ uvaꞌ tal kan u Moisés. As jit tetz u Moisés u yoleꞌ, pet Tiixh kat alon te unqꞌa qꞌesla ebꞌaaleꞌ. As kꞌuxh tu u xeem qꞌii ni chit ebꞌaneꞌ.

Asoj ni tuch itzokꞌax el unbꞌiil ichiꞌol umaj neꞌ xaak tu u xeem qꞌiieꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ la epaasa tzii tiꞌ u tzaqꞌiteꞌ uvaꞌ tal kan u Moisés, as ¿kam qꞌi uveꞌ ni tul eviꞌ sviꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat unbꞌaꞌnxisa umaꞌl u aachꞌoꞌm tu u xeem qꞌiieꞌ?
As jikoj chit ebꞌan unsuuchil. As ebꞌantaj teviꞌ asoj bꞌaꞌn nunbꞌaneꞌ moj yeꞌle,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
Niyolbꞌe unqꞌa tenameꞌ u Jesús
As ech tal veꞌt kaꞌl unqꞌa aa Jerusalén ileꞌ svatzaj tiꞌ u Jesús: —¿Ma jit u najeꞌ nichukpeꞌ uvaꞌ ni talax iyatzꞌpeꞌ?
As il naj ileꞌ niyolon xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As yeꞌxhkam kuxh ni talax tiꞌ naj. Kamal naꞌl vatz unqꞌa kubꞌooqꞌoleꞌ uvaꞌ aꞌ u Cristoeꞌ u najeꞌ.
Pet ootzimal sqaꞌn uvaꞌ katil tzaakat naj. Pet ech koj u Cristo, tan tul la ul Aak, as yeꞌxhebꞌil la ootzin katil la tzaakat Aak,— tiꞌk unqꞌa tenameꞌ svatzaj.

As tul nikat ichusun u Jesús vatz iqꞌanal u tostiixheꞌ, as taqꞌ veꞌt jeꞌ Aak tuul iviꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: —Ootzimal in setaꞌn. As ootzimal setaꞌn uvaꞌ katil tzaanajkat in. As yeꞌl uvaꞌ kat kuxh koj ul in tukꞌ untxumbꞌal. Pet aꞌ u jikla Tiixheꞌ kat chajon tzan in uvaꞌ yeꞌ ootzimal setaꞌn.
As ootzimal Aak svaꞌn, tan kꞌatz Aak tzaanajkat in. As Aakeꞌ chajon tzan in,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
As kꞌuxh nik tal veꞌt unqꞌa iqꞌesal unqꞌa tenameꞌ itxeyat Aak, as yeꞌxhebꞌil kat txeyon Aak, tan yeꞌxnik ilejat u qꞌiieꞌ uvaꞌ la txeypu veꞌt Aak.

As yeꞌ saach unqꞌa tenameꞌ ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak. Ech nik tal veꞌt ileꞌ svatzaj: —Asoj jit u Cristo u Jesús, as tul la ul u Cristo, as ¿la kol pal veꞌt vibꞌaꞌnileꞌ qꞌa tiꞌ u mamaꞌla kꞌuchbꞌal tetz u tijleꞌm u Jesús uveꞌ kat ibꞌanlu veꞌteꞌ?— tiꞌk unqꞌa tenameꞌ.
Chajax bꞌen kaꞌl unqꞌa naj tiꞌ itxeypu u Jesús

As tabꞌi veꞌt unqꞌa fariseo unqꞌa yoleꞌ uvaꞌ nik tal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tiꞌ u Jesús. As imol veꞌt tibꞌ chajnaj tukꞌ unqꞌa iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh. As ichaj veꞌt bꞌen chajnaj kaꞌl unqꞌa xeen tetz u tostiixheꞌ tiꞌ itxeypu u Jesús.
As ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ: —Unbꞌiitoj kuxheꞌ tuk unbꞌan sexoꞌl. As tuk qꞌaavoj veꞌt in kꞌatz u chajol vetzeꞌ.
As kꞌuxh la echuk veꞌt in, as echeꞌ la koj elej veꞌt in, tan la koj uch etooneꞌ tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ uveꞌ la atinkat in,— tiꞌk u Jesús.

As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa fariseo ileꞌ svatzaj tukꞌ unqꞌa iqꞌesal unqꞌa nachol Tiixheꞌ: —¿Katileꞌ qꞌi la bꞌenkat u najeꞌ uveꞌ ni taleꞌ, uvaꞌ yeꞌ la kulej veꞌt naj? ¿Ma aꞌ la bꞌenkat naj bꞌa xoꞌl unqꞌa kumooleꞌ uvaꞌ jejleꞌl xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ jit tiaal Israel? ¿Pet moj la bꞌen ichus veꞌt naj unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ jit tiaal Israel?
¿As kam ni tokkat viyol najeꞌ uveꞌ ni taleꞌ: «Kꞌuxh la echuk in, as yeꞌl in la elej veꞌt in. As la koj etxꞌol etooneꞌ tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ uveꞌ la atinkat in,» taqꞌ kuxh naj ni taleꞌ,— tiꞌk chajnaj?
Niyolon u Jesús tiꞌ u Tiixhla Espíritu

As timoxtebꞌal u nimla qꞌiieꞌ as aꞌ u qꞌiieꞌ uveꞌ nim talcheꞌ tu u nimla qꞌiieꞌ. As txakpu veꞌt u Jesús vatz unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As taqꞌ veꞌt jeꞌ Aak tuul iviꞌ. Ech tal Aak ileꞌ: —Abꞌiste ex nitzaj etziꞌ as etoksataj etibꞌ sunkꞌatz. As ukꞌaꞌoj ex sunkꞌatz,

tan abꞌil uvaꞌ la ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ ikꞌuꞌl sviꞌ as ech la ibꞌaneꞌ echeꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan tu viyol u Tiixheꞌ. Tan ech tel chꞌuꞌl vunbꞌaꞌnileꞌ tu u taanxelaleꞌ echeꞌ nibꞌan u aꞌeꞌ tul ni tel chꞌuꞌl tu u vitzeꞌ uvaꞌ ni aqꞌon tiichajil,— tiꞌk u Jesús.

As aꞌ u Tiixhla Espíritu nikat tal Aak, uvaꞌ la ok veꞌt tu u taanxelal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ la ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak, tan yeꞌxnik ul u Tiixhla Espíritu tiꞌ tok tu u taanxelal unqꞌa niman tetz Aakeꞌ. As yeꞌxnik oon Aak tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ uveꞌ la oksalkat iqꞌiia Aak kꞌatz viBꞌaaleꞌ.
Yeꞌ nik ikꞌul tibꞌ iyol unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ nichꞌoꞌn taama tiꞌ u Jesús

As tul tabꞌi veꞌt unqꞌa tenameꞌ unqꞌa yoleꞌ uveꞌ tal u Jesús, as ech tal veꞌt unjolol unqꞌa naj ileꞌ: —An chiteꞌ vil. Aꞌ u qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ kat ulyu veꞌteꞌ uvaꞌ alel kan u tulebꞌaleꞌ,— tiꞌk chajnaj.
As ech tal unjoltu unqꞌa naj ileꞌ: —An chiteꞌ. Aꞌ u Cristo kat ulyu veꞌteꞌ,— tiꞌk chajnaj. As atik kaꞌt uxhchil uvaꞌ ech tal ileꞌ: —¿As tu kol u Galilea qꞌa la tzaakat u Cristo?
¿As yeꞌ kol qꞌa sekꞌuꞌl uvaꞌ alel kan tu viyol u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ tiaal David u Cristo la ibꞌaneꞌ? Tan aꞌ la tzaakat tu u Belén, uvaꞌ atikkat u David,— tiꞌk unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.
As yeꞌ nik ikꞌul tibꞌ iyol unqꞌa tenameꞌ svatzaj tiꞌ u Jesús.
As atik unjolol unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ nik alon uvaꞌ la txeyax Aak. As yeꞌxhebꞌil kat txeyon Aak.
Ni tal unqꞌa najeꞌ kam stiꞌ yeꞌ kat itxeykat chajnaj u Jesús

As tul qꞌaav veꞌt unqꞌa xeen tetz u tostiixheꞌ uvaꞌ maꞌtik ichajax bꞌen taꞌn unqꞌa iqꞌesal oksan iyol tenam vatz Tiixh tukꞌ unqꞌa fariseo tiꞌ itxeypu veꞌt u Jesús, as ech alpu veꞌt ileꞌ te chajnaj: —¿Kam tetzeꞌ uveꞌ yeꞌ kat eteqꞌo tzan u Jesús?— tiꞌk unqꞌa chajol tetz chajnajeꞌ.
Ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa xeen tetz u tostiixh ileꞌ: —As yeꞌ atixoj qabꞌi iyolon umaj uxhchil uvaꞌ achaꞌv iyoloneꞌ echeꞌ iyolon u najeꞌ,— tiꞌk chajnaj.
As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa fariseo ileꞌ te chajnaj: —¿Ma antu veꞌt ex bꞌa kat yanyu veꞌt etxumbꞌal taꞌn u najeꞌ?
¿As ma yeꞌ ootzimal setaꞌn uvaꞌ yeꞌl umaj unqꞌa kuqꞌesaleꞌ ni niman u najeꞌ? As mitaꞌn oꞌ uvaꞌ oꞌ fariseo ni niman naj.
As jankꞌal unqꞌa tenameꞌ uveꞌ ni niman u najeꞌ, as niyansa veꞌt tibꞌ, tan echeꞌ ootzimal koj u tzaqꞌiteꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn naj,— tiꞌk unqꞌa fariseo.
As u Nicodemo uvaꞌ bꞌex yolon xeꞌ u Jesús aqꞌbꞌal, tan imool tibꞌ naj tukꞌ unqꞌa fariseo. As ech tal veꞌt naj ileꞌ te vimooleꞌ:
—Palojtaj oꞌ stuul uvaꞌ aꞌ ni tal u kuleyeꞌ uvaꞌ lanal qabꞌi isuuchil bꞌaxa. As aꞌn la qal itxeypu umaj uxhchil tul uvaꞌ la qootzi vipaaveꞌ,— tiꞌk naj.

As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa imool naj ileꞌ: —¿As ma aꞌ nooksakat eebꞌ kꞌatz unqꞌa aa Galilea? ¡Chus eebꞌ sbꞌaꞌn tiꞌ viyol u Tiixheꞌ, tan yeꞌl umaj qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ aa Galilea!— tiꞌk chajnaj.
As ijatx veꞌt tibꞌ chajnaj. As bꞌen veꞌt chajnaj tulaj ikabꞌal.
